title: The *** WIN epilogue recaps the Vale, Fenmarch, Hollowbrook, and Iron Downs threads by name, but never mentions Thornwold's pardoned Hanged Company or Wardmoor's relit beacon/laid sentry, and gives no closure line for any companion's personal arc (whether Cal stayed home, what came of Vell's exiled bloodline), despite all of those being fully resolved quests going into the ending.
